item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00171","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C07","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C11 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both authorize loans under section 302 of the Defense Production Act using the distinctive parenthetical formulation “including participations in, or guarantees of, loans,” condition assistance on financing not being available on reasonable terms, and connect eligibility to a national-defense determination by the Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization. The child materially condenses and adapts this machinery from loans for productive capacity and essential materials to reconstruction of disaster-damaged defense facilities. C07 and C04 contain substantially the same earlier loan framework, but C11 is the closest and most recent formulation.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"provision may be made for loans (including participations in, or guarantees of, loans) under Section 302 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary ... is hereby authorized and directed to make loans (including participations in, or guarantees of, loans) ... as authorized by and subject to section 302 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended.","explanation":"Distinctive shared loan formulation and identical statutory machinery."},{"child_excerpt":"Whenever financial assistance is not otherwise available on reasonable terms","parent_excerpt":"shall be made only after the Secretary has determined in each instance that financial assistance is not available on reasonable terms from private sources or from other governmental sources","explanation":"The child closely condenses C11’s prerequisite for using the federal loan authority."},{"child_excerpt":"whenever such facilities are required for national defense as determined by the Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization","parent_excerpt":"shall be made only upon certificate of essentiality of the loan, which certificate shall be made by the Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization","explanation":"Both assign the decisive national-defense or essentiality determination to the same official, with the child adapting the finding to disaster-damaged facilities."}]}
